newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down marginally on initial high offers.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down marginally on initial high offers.

text.p: Tin price ended five cents lower at 14.80 ringgit ($5.87) a kg as sentiment was affected by a lower close in the London Metal Exchange overnight.
Traders said an initial high offerings also eased the market which saw an opening offer of 100 tonnes against bid of 61 tonnes. Final turnover was 85 tonnes against 90 on Tuesday.

Some local, Japanese and European buying was seen at lower levels. "The market was a bit easier because of lower LME and is expected to hover at around current levels," a dealer said. The local price over LME was at a $15 discount against $10 discount on Tuesday.--Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911) ($1=2.5210 ringgit)
